directions.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a final professionally art-directed ORIGINAL logo for Indian biryani brand DUM E ODISHA. This is a structural redesign of the supplied prior logo, because its merged 'dume' lettering is rejected. Do not reproduce that merged lettering. Maintain only the warm flat illustrative character and cooking/lid cue. Research-led goals: impeccable readable typography, a hierarchy that can work on a delivery bag, restrained warm two-ink palette, optical balance, no generic clip art. DUM and E MUST be separate units with a conspicuous REAL WHITE SPACE GAP, at least half the width of the letter U. Never connect M to E; never bridge them with a lid, swoosh or line. Main brand text EXACTLY 'DUM E' on the top name line and 'ODISHA' below. ODISHA is part of the brand, not a tiny location footer. It should span the same overall width as DUM+E and be substantial. Small optional tagline precisely 'FLAVOUR IN EVERY LAYER.' beneath with generous breathing space. No word BIRYANI anywhere. No crowns, royal seals, founding dates, maps, temples, chakra, spices, chili pepper, monograms or invented tradition. Uniform warm white #FFF9EF backdrop; flat deep chilli #8B3029 and saffron #E6AB44 only, no gradients, grain, bevels, shadows or 3D. Small independent stylised lifting cooking lid (not a giant pot) above the name, less than 15 percent of total logo height, with clear separation from letters; no illustration inside a letter. Mature contemporary Indian restaurant identity, warm bespoke-looking low-contrast serif lettering with well-resolved curves, not bubble type and not the original distorted lowercase m. All letters must be instantly recognisable. One complete standalone logo only, no board, no mockups, no extra text. Center on a square canvas, artwork 70% width, ample margins. Main top name line: DUM in robust deep-chilli display serif capitals. A smaller uppercase E, half the DUM cap height, sits to its right at optical centre in its own saffron rounded-square cartouche, with deep-chilli letter E. Cartouche is independent with obvious gap, not joined to M. Main ODISHA line in deep chilli elegant robust sans capitals. Small lid in deep chilli with saffron rim. Exact three typographic levels: DUM [E] / ODISHA / FLAVOUR IN EVERY LAYER. Restrained precise proportions, no exuberant flourishes.
